subject.title: memory: add local continuity snapshot helpers

question: Should OpenClaw publish this `memory/recent` Markdown format and its 13 new memory-host runtime-files exports as a core contract before a runtime hook or compaction consumer lands?
rationale: The branch is intentionally foundation-only, so source review cannot determine whether these names, fields, and storage semantics are the permanent core API or premature surface that later integration work would need to change.

options.title: Approve a narrowed foundation
options.body: Accept the continuity format in core after the filesystem defect is fixed, trimming exports to the minimum contract maintainers are prepared to support.

options.title: Land with the first consumer
options.body: Pause this branch and review the helpers together with an accepted hook or recovery consumer so the API is derived from real call-site requirements.

options.title: Keep continuity outside core
options.body: Decline the new core SDK/file-format surface and route the workflow through an existing memory plugin or a plugin-owned implementation.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrowed foundation
recommendation.body: Accept the continuity format in core after the filesystem defect is fixed, trimming exports to the minimum contract maintainers are prepared to support.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most strongly connects steipete to the package and runtime-files contract whose public direction must be decided.
